versions.changelog:
Initial release – formalizes and automates formatting workflows for Chinese and English academic papers.

- Supports only Word (.doc/.docx) and LaTeX (.tex or validated project ZIP) source files; PDF, images, and other formats are not accepted for formatting.
- Distinguishes formatting rules by paper type: graduation/thesis, academic/journal, coursework, or others; applies user/institution templates when available.
- Enforces strict output: only one final, editable manuscript (.docx or .tex) is delivered—no scripts, intermediate files, or logs are attached or linked.
- Comprehensive validation: automated checks for structure, styles, headers/footers, line spacing, black text, and references, with compliance options (auto/required/skip).
- Cautiously handles file conversions and enforces cleanup of temporary scripts/files; prohibits making up text, references, or content.
- Provides clear rejection reasons and instructions for unsupported or blank files, and never creates content for missing sections unless explicitly requested.
